literal_meaning: ঘরকে জোড়া বা পূর্ণ করা (house joining or completing)
figurative_meaning_en: Filling an empty house or bringing completeness to a barren home
example_sentences_in_bangla: নতুন বৌ এসে ঘর জোড়া করেছে।
ভাইয়ের বিয়ের পর ঘর জোড়া হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The new bride has filled the empty house.
After my brother's wedding, the home feels complete.
note: Often used in contexts of marriage revitalizing a family home in traditional Bengali society.
